marketMood: Risk-on with caveats: Iran diplomacy crushes oil prices and fuels a broad tech rally, but China PMI contraction and Japan yen intervention signal persistent macro headwinds.

AMD Q2 Earnings after close — AI data center revenue closely watched

topStories.headline: Trump Cancels Iran Strike, Oil Tumbles 5–6% as Hormuz Talks Resume
topStories.summary: President Trump called off planned military strikes against Iran and revived diplomatic talks aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz and halting Tehran's nuclear program; new negotiations began Monday.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↓4.8% to ~$83.70; WTI ↓6% to ~$79.60; lower energy costs eased inflation fears, triggering a broad equity rally ↑

topStories.headline: AI Hyperscalers Surge — Amazon Crosses $3 Trillion Market Cap for First Time
topStories.summary: Post-earnings momentum from Microsoft and Amazon drove megacap tech sharply higher: Amazon +4.6%, Microsoft +4.9%, Meta +6–7%, Alphabet +4.9%, Nvidia +2.9%; Amazon crossed the $3 trillion market cap mark for the first time.
topStories.marketImpact: S&P 500 ↑1.48% to 7,600; Nasdaq ↑2.1% to 25,914; Dow ↑1.32% to 53,178; broad risk-on rally ↑

topStories.headline: SpaceX Reports First-Ever Public Earnings After Market Close Today
topStories.summary: SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX) releases Q2 results after market close — investors' first audited look at its three-segment business spanning space, connectivity, and AI post-xAI integration; Wall Street consensus revenue is $6.82 billion.
topStories.marketImpact: SPCX ↑/↓ watch — stock has fallen 45%+ since its record June IPO; Starlink profitability and AI capex guidance are the key tests

topStories.headline: AMD Q2 Earnings: Data Center Revenue Expected to Double Year-on-Year
topStories.summary: AMD reports Q2 after market close with consensus revenue of $11.3 billion (+47% YoY); the data center segment is expected at $6.5 billion, more than double Q2 2025, driven by Instinct AI accelerators and EPYC CPUs.
topStories.marketImpact: AMD ↑ watch on a beat; guidance on MI350 chips and Helios rack-scale systems will set the tone for chipmakers heading into H2

topStories.headline: Caterpillar Q2 Before the Bell — Infrastructure Capex Cycle in Focus
topStories.summary: Caterpillar reports Q2 before market open with consensus EPS of $6.25 (+32% YoY) and revenue of $19.3 billion (+16.6% YoY); the company has beaten estimates in three of its last four quarters.
topStories.marketImpact: CAT ↑ watch if results confirm trend; key bellwether for global construction and mining spending cycle ↑

topStories.headline: China Manufacturing PMI Falls to 49.2 — First Contraction in Five Months
topStories.summary: China's official manufacturing PMI fell to 49.2 in July from 50.3 in June, missing forecasts; new orders dropped to 48.5, the lowest since 2023, while services and construction PMIs also slipped into contraction amid weak domestic demand and typhoon disruptions.
topStories.marketImpact: Hang Seng edged up only 0.1% as sentiment soured; commodity demand concerns ↓; Beijing pledged accelerated fiscal spending for H2

topStories.headline: Japan and US Execute Coordinated $34 Billion Yen-Buying Intervention
topStories.summary: Japan's Ministry of Finance and the US Treasury confirmed joint yen-buying intervention after USD/JPY neared 40-year lows; BOJ data pointed to approximately $34 billion deployed on Friday, setting a new monthly record.
topStories.marketImpact: USD/JPY ↓ (yen strengthening); Nikkei 225 ↓0.6% to ~63,300 as stronger yen weighs on exporter earnings; 9984.T ↓2.4%, 6857.T ↓2.2%, 8306.T ↓1.8%

topStories.headline: BOJ Holds Rates at 1%, Signals Core Inflation Likely to Exceed 2% Target
topStories.summary: The Bank of Japan kept its benchmark rate at 1% at its July meeting in an 8-1 vote, with one board member dissenting for an immediate hike to 1.25%; BOJ projects core inflation will run clearly above 2% from H2 FY2026.
topStories.marketImpact: Rate hike expectations creeping higher ↑; JGB yields ↑ watch; yen positioning increasingly complex given simultaneous intervention pressure
